title: Taiwan Fund Managers Quit Jobs to Trade Their Own Money in Stock Boom
description: The world’s biggest equity rally is creating an unusual bout of FOMO among Taiwan’s professional stock pickers.

title: Stocks Rotate as Tech & Chip Shares Slide
description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Charles Schwab Chief Investment Strategist Liz Ann Sonders, IDC Senior Director, Data & Analytics Nabila Popal, Susquehanna Senior Equity Research Analyst Mehdi Hosseini, KPMG US Chair & CEO Tim Walsh, Envestnet CIO Dana D’Auria, Hirtle & Co Founder & Executive Chair Jon Hirtle, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management President & CEO Ross Gerber, Blue Sky Productions President John McElroy, & Porsche CEO Michael Leiters. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MSCI Decision Moves Michael Saylor’s Strategy Toward Index Exit
description: MSCI Inc. adopted new rules that could ultimately push Strategy Inc. out of its global equity benchmarks, potentially triggering billions of dollars in stock sales and adding fresh pressure to the financing model behind Michael Saylor’s vast Bitcoin holdings.
